ItemID: NA; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My recent listening makes this reflective, familiar rock sound appealing; I would try it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lighthouse; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The acoustic direction appeals to me, but I would stick to my strongest choices this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-driven guitar fits my interest in People, Hell & Angels, though I would save this for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues and roots sound fits my listening, but I am only choosing a couple of albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Low Country Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The earthy blues direction strongly matches what I want after Memphis and Old Sock; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Muddy Waters & The Rolling Stones Live At The Checkerboard Lounge, Chicago 1981 DVD/CD; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues collaboration interests me, but I am less inclined to choose a live DVD/CD package today.
ItemID: NA; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic rock harmonies appeal to me, but I am not looking for an extensive live collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The 1971 Fillmore East Recordings; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-rock performances fit my taste, but a lengthy archival release feels like a bigger commitment today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sunken Condos; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The polished songwriting sounds appealing alongside You Should Be So Lucky, but it is a lower priority today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Jake Bugg; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in established blues and classic rock sounds than trying this folk-rock direction right now.
